title.narrative: SCIMITAR–SA Trial - Smoking Cessation For People With Severe Illness In South Asia (SCIMITAR SA)

description.narrative: People with serious mental illnesses experience poor physical health and reduced life expectancy. Tobacco use is a long-term condition in itself, which can also lead to the development of other long-term conditions. It is one of the biggest preventable factors responsible for health inequality but remains unaddressed among people with serious mental illnesses who live in low-resource settings such as South Asia. Our team has several years of experience in working with people who have serious mental illness and have made significant advances in recent years in the UK and South Asia. We have conducted research into the causes of health inequalities for people with serious mental illness in both settings. We have established a shared understanding of the nature of this problem under an initiative to build sustainable global collaborations. In South Asia, we have made advancements under our IMPACT Global Health Research Group (now a Centre) by developing a culturally-appropriate behavioural treatment to help people with serious mental illness in India and Pakistan to quit smoking. In the current programme, we will build on our previous research and experience, extending to three South Asian countries (Bangladesh, India and Pakistan) with a high prevalence of tobacco use. We will adapt the previously developed treatment to cater to a wider group of individuals, including those who live in Bangladesh as well as those who use smokeless tobacco. We will then test this treatment in a large clinical trial (‘a fair test’) to see if offering tobacco cessation works and is value for money. Conducting a large trial is a complex undertaking, and we have significant expertise in this area. Our team includes experts from a range of backgrounds, as such research requires a range of perspectives. We will use valid and reliable tests to assess the success of our treatment in helping people to quit tobacco. We will also find out which strategies are useful in delivering tobacco cessation in mental health facilities. Alongside the research, we will develop expertise in conducting research in mental health, train clinicians to deliver tobacco cessation treatments and support policymakers in using our research findings in practice.
